interpretation: Three independent repeats of seven unique arms. Exact production-hybrid C2 control is reused across E1, E3 and critic E4; both table-aware BM25 and plain-text BM25 remain separate for representation E4. No publication. Partial/unrun jobs never count as completed experiments. All arms use the same prespecified concurrency of six. Wall-clock latency is measured under this shared load; it is not isolated single-request latency. C0 uses fixed code collection and at most one tool-free LLM risk-writing response; numeric-only drafts are deterministic. C1 uses one ReAct worker without a separate model critic. Both retain the same deterministic validation and source reverification as the critic-off team arm. Before any held-out outcome, the frozen queue alternates numeric and risk cases ordered by a fixed case-ID hash seed, queueing each case’s seven arms across three repeats as one contiguous block before the next case block. All planned jobs remain; early stopping never implies full-corpus completion. Main held-out comparisons precede memory and serial security assays.
